WITH LOT_DATA AS ( SELECT T.TECH , T.PRODG1 , T.PRODSPEC_ID , T.LOCATION_FAB , T.FAB , T.LAYER , T.NENG_FLAG , T.LOT_ID , T.WAFER_QTY , T.CUR_OPE_NO , T.OPE_NO , B.OPE_SEQ AS OPER_SEQ , DECODE(T.CUR_OPE_NO ,T.OPE_NO,'当站','Coming') AS WIP_CATEGORY , T.FCST_TIME , T.FCST_SHIFT_DATE , T.CLOSE_HOUR , T.SGS_GROUP , T.SGS_EQP , T.MAINPD_ID , T.STD_CT_END , T.MIN_STD_TIME , T.SGS_FIRST_OP , T.INLINE_CYC_ACC , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T.LOT_ID, T.FCST_SHIFT_DATE ORDER BY T.OPE_SEQ) RN FROM A1MFG.PR_SGS_EQP_WIP T LEFT JOIN A1MFG.TECH_FLOW_MAINTAIN B ON T.TECH = B.TECH AND T.OPE_NO = B.OPE_NO WHERE 1=1 AND T.FCST_SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE -7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE -7.5/24 +6,'YYYYMMDD')
AND T.NENG_FLAG LIKE '%'
AND T.NENG_FLAG =#{neng}
AND T.SGS_EQP = #{eqpid} ) , CURRENT_WIP AS ( SELECT A.TECH , A.SGS_GROUP , A.OPE_NO , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS CURRENT_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS CURRENT_N1A3_WIP FROM LOT_DATA A WHERE A.RN = 1 AND WIP_CATEGORY ='当站' GROUP BY A.TECH, A.SGS_GROUP, A.OPE_NO ) , COMING_WIP AS ( SELECT A.TECH , A.SGS_GROUP , A.OPE_NO , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS TD_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS TD_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+1,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY1_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+1,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY1_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+2,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY2_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+2,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY2_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+3,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY3_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+3,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY3_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+4,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY4_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+4,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY4_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+5,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY5_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+5,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY5_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+6,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY6_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+6,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY6_N1A3_WIP FROM LOT_DATA A WHERE A.RN = 1 AND A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+6,'YYYYMMDD') AND WIP_CATEGORY = 'Coming' GROUP BY TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO ) , MAIN_RESULT AS ( SELECT DISTINCT C.TECH , C.SGS_GROUP , C.OPE_NO , C.OPER_SEQ , NVL(B.CURRENT_N1A1_WIP,0) AS CURRENT_N1A1_WIP , NVL(B.CURRENT_N1A3_WIP,0) AS CURRENT_N1A3_WIP , NVL(A.TD_N1A1_WIP,0) AS TD_N1A1_WIP , NVL(A.TD_N1A3_WIP,0) AS TD_N1A3_WIP , NVL(A.DAY1_N1A1_WIP,0) AS DAY1_N1A1_WIP , NVL(A.DAY1_N1A3_WIP,0) AS DAY1_N1A3_WIP , NVL(A.DAY2_N1A1_WIP,0) AS DAY2_N1A1_WIP , NVL(A.DAY2_N1A3_WIP,0) AS DAY2_N1A3_WIP , NVL(A.DAY3_N1A1_WIP,0) AS DAY3_N1A1_WIP , NVL(A.DAY3_N1A3_WIP,0) AS DAY3_N1A3_WIP , NVL(A.DAY4_N1A1_WIP,0) AS DAY4_N1A1_WIP , NVL(A.DAY4_N1A3_WIP,0) AS DAY4_N1A3_WIP , NVL(A.DAY5_N1A1_WIP,0) AS DAY5_N1A1_WIP , NVL(A.DAY5_N1A3_WIP,0) AS DAY5_N1A3_WIP , NVL(A.DAY6_N1A1_WIP,0) AS DAY6_N1A1_WIP , NVL(A.DAY6_N1A3_WIP,0) AS DAY6_N1A3_WIP FROM LOT_DATA C LEFT JOIN COMING_WIP A ON A.TECH = C.TECH AND A.SGS_GROUP = C.SGS_GROUP AND A.OPE_NO = C.OPE_NO LEFT JOIN CURRENT_WIP B ON C.TECH = B.TECH AND C.SGS_GROUP = B.SGS_GROUP AND C.OPE_NO = B.OPE_NO WHERE C.RN =1 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) = 3 THEN TECH -- TECH小计 WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) = 7 THEN 'Total' -- 总计 ELSE TECH END AS TECH , CASE WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) = 3 THEN 'Total' -- TECH小计 WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) = 7 THEN 'Total' -- 总计 ELSE SGS_GROUP END AS SGS_GROUP , CASE WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) = 3 THEN 'Total' -- TECH小计 WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) = 7 THEN 'Total' -- 总计 ELSE OPE_NO END AS OPE_NO , SUM(CURRENT_N1A1_WIP) AS CURRENT_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CURRENT_N1A3_WIP) AS CURRENT_N1A3_WIP , SUM(TD_N1A1_WIP) AS TD_N1A1_WIP , SUM(TD_N1A3_WIP) AS TD_N1A3_WIP , SUM(DAY1_N1A1_WIP) AS DAY1_N1A1_WIP , SUM(DAY1_N1A3_WIP) AS DAY1_N1A3_WIP , SUM(DAY2_N1A1_WIP) AS DAY2_N1A1_WIP , SUM(DAY2_N1A3_WIP) AS DAY2_N1A3_WIP , SUM(DAY3_N1A1_WIP) AS DAY3_N1A1_WIP , SUM(DAY3_N1A3_WIP) AS DAY3_N1A3_WIP , SUM(DAY4_N1A1_WIP) AS DAY4_N1A1_WIP , SUM(DAY4_N1A3_WIP) AS DAY4_N1A3_WIP , SUM(DAY5_N1A1_WIP) AS DAY5_N1A1_WIP , SUM(DAY5_N1A3_WIP) AS DAY5_N1A3_WIP , SUM(DAY6_N1A1_WIP) AS DAY6_N1A1_WIP , SUM(DAY6_N1A3_WIP) AS DAY6_N1A3_WIP , GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) AS GRP_ID FROM MAIN_RESULT GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO,OPER_SEQ), (TECH), () ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN TECH = 'Total' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, TECH, CASE WHEN SGS_GROUP = 'Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, SGS_GROUP,OPER_SEQ, OPE_NO

WITH LOT_DATA AS ( SELECT T.TECH , T.PRODG1 , T.PRODSPEC_ID , T.LOCATION_FAB , T.FAB , T.LAYER , T.NENG_FLAG , T.LOT_ID , T.WAFER_QTY , T.CUR_OPE_NO , T.OPE_NO , B.OPE_SEQ AS OPER_SEQ , DECODE(T.CUR_OPE_NO ,T.OPE_NO,'当站','Coming') AS WIP_CATEGORY , T.FCST_TIME , T.FCST_SHIFT_DATE , T.CLOSE_HOUR , T.SGS_GROUP , T.SGS_EQP , T.MAINPD_ID , T.STD_CT_END , T.MIN_STD_TIME , T.SGS_FIRST_OP , T.INLINE_CYC_ACC FROM A1MFG.PR_SGS_EQP_WIP T LEFT JOIN A1MFG.TECH_FLOW_MAINTAIN B ON T.TECH = B.TECH AND T.OPE_NO = B.OPE_NO WHERE 1=1 AND T.FCST_SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE -7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE -7.5/24 +6,'YYYYMMDD')

A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+2,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY2_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+2,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY2_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+3,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY3_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+3,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY3_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+4,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY4_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+4,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY4_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+5,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY5_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+5,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY5_N1A3_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+6,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY6_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+6,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.FAB = 'N1A3' THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS DAY6_N1A3_WIP FROM LOT_DATA A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.FCST_SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24+6,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.WIP_CATEGORY = 'Coming' GROUP BY A.TECH, A.SGS_GROUP, , NVL(A.DAY2_N1A3_WIP,0) AS DAY2_N1A3_WIP , NVL(A.DAY3_N1A1_WIP,0) AS DAY3_N1A1_WIP , NVL(A.DAY3_N1A3_WIP,0) AS DAY3_N1A3_WIP , NVL(A.DAY4_N1A1_WIP,0) AS DAY4_N1A1_WIP , NVL(A.DAY4_N1A3_WIP,0) AS SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) = 3 THEN TECH -- TECH小计 WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) = 7 THEN 'Total' -- 总计 ELSE TECH END AS TECH , CASE WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, 'Total' -- TECH小计 WHEN GROUPING_ID(TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO) = 7 THEN 'Total' -- 总计 ELSE OPE_NO END AS OPE_NO , SUM(CURRENT_N1A1_WIP) AS CURRENT_N1A1_WIP , SUM(CURRENT_N1A3_WIP) AS CURRENT_N1A3_WIP , AS DAY2_N1A3_WIP , SUM(DAY3_N1A1_WIP) AS DAY3_N1A1_WIP , SUM(DAY3_N1A3_WIP) AS DAY3_N1A3_WIP , SUM(DAY4_N1A1_WIP) AS DAY4_N1A1_WIP , SUM(DAY4_N1A3_WIP) AS DAY4_N1A3_WIP , SUM(DAY5_N1A1_WIP) AS BY GROUPING SETS ( (TECH, SGS_GROUP, OPE_NO,OPER_SEQ), (TECH), () ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN TECH = 'Total' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, TECH, CASE WHEN SGS_GROUP = 'Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, SGS_GROUP,OPER_SEQ, OPE_NO

SELECT EQPID_LABEL, EQPID_VALUE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SGS_EQP AS EQPID_LABEL , SGS_EQP AS EQPID_VALUE , CASE WHEN LENGTH(SGS_EQP) =5 THEN 'N1A1' ELSE 'N1A3' END AS FAB FROM A1MFG.PR_SGS_EQP_WIP ) WHERE FAB =#{fab} ORDER BY EQPID_LABEL
